# Flowchart

Show the steps and decisions in a process.

## Example 1

=== "Diagram"

    ```mermaid
    flowchart LR
        subgraph subgraph1
            direction TB
            top1[top] --> bottom1[bottom]
        end
        subgraph subgraph2
            direction TB
            top2[top] --> bottom2[bottom]
        end
        %% ^ These subgraphs are identical, except for the links to them:

        %% Link *to* subgraph1: subgraph1 direction is maintained
        outside --> subgraph1
        %% Link *within* subgraph2:
        %% subgraph2 inherits the direction of the top-level graph (LR)
        outside ---> top2
    ```

=== "Markdown"

    ````markdown
    ```mermaid
    flowchart LR
        subgraph subgraph1
            direction TB
            top1[top] --> bottom1[bottom]
        end
        subgraph subgraph2
            direction TB
            top2[top] --> bottom2[bottom]
        end
        %% ^ These subgraphs are identical, except for the links to them:

        %% Link *to* subgraph1: subgraph1 direction is maintained
        outside --> subgraph1
        %% Link *within* subgraph2:
        %% subgraph2 inherits the direction of the top-level graph (LR)
        outside ---> top2
    ```
    ````

## Example 2

=== "Diagram"

    ```mermaid
    ---
    config:
      theme: default
      look: classic
      layout: dagre
    ---
    flowchart LR
      subgraph Client
        UI[Web app]
        Cache[(Local cache)]
      end
      subgraph Services
        API[API gateway]
        Auth[Auth service]
        Orders[Order service]
      end
      subgraph Storage
        DB[(Orders DB)]
      end
      UI --> API
      UI --> Cache
      API --> Auth
      API --> Orders
      Orders --> DB
      Auth -. token .-> UI
    ```

=== "Markdown"

      Orders --> DB
      Auth -. token .-> UI
